name: Nathan Streifel
biography: Nathan Streifel is a Los Angeles based actor, of Chinese, Hispanic, and German descent. He was born and raised in Aberdeen, Washington, a small logging town in the Olympic Peninsula. He received his MFA in Acting from The Theatre School at DePaul University in Chicago, and has a BA in Psychology from Western Washington University. He won the National College Improv Championship as a member of WWU's Dead Parrot's Society, and received a KCACTF acting nomination for his role as Wilson in the play The Mistakes Madeline Made.
